fusions.name: Lowered Horns
fusions.desc: Butts the target with your full weight, which deals 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Off the Ledge
fusions.desc: Kicks out in a cone 3.5 tiles long, which deals 12 damage to everything in it and knocks each enemy back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Unbudging
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Stubborn Footing
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12% at all times.
